conventions: Use seed20261030 for task-group split and opaque ID assignment; no scientific threshold changed.

All four cue manipulations are in the SYSTEM message, as §247 explicitly requires. Sycophancy system sentence attributes the confident wrong prior to the user; control attributes a neutral query. Misuse contrasts cheating against studying. Tool and withhold contrast the exact cue against no added sentence.

Twenty-five fixed benign base questions use frozen factual true/wrong single-word candidates; four shared task paraphrases are verbatim identical within every cue pair. Withhold refers to that task's true benign fact, not an unrelated fact.
Hold out whole base tasks: five tasks times four templates give20DEV pairs per cue; remaining20tasks times four templates give80TEST. Same split in all cues. No base task crosses DEV/TEST.

Qwen pinned chat template, add_generation_prompt=true and enable_thinking=false; read at final rendered token. Preserve complete raw chat without truncation. No ratio or BOW exclusion gate is introduced for explicit cue presence/absence.

Public answer pair token IDs are sorted ascending, without truth signs; CPU-only file holds correct/wrong and cue/split/task/pair labels. Leading-space single-token candidates are checked with the pinned tokenizer.
